name: fable
description: Fable is an open-source AI workspace for real work.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fable/protocol build && pnpm --filter @fable/connectors build && pnpm --filter @fable/broker build && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop build && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing build && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @fable/protocol build && pnpm --filter @fable/connectors build && pnpm --filter @fable/broker typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge build && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/marketing typecheck && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @fable/connectors test && pnpm --filter @fable/broker test && pnpm --filter @fable/knowledge test && pnpm --filter @fable/desktop test && pnpm --filter @fable/waitlist test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm tauri:check
